description: Pins protocol::validate_min_length — the master-password minimum-length floor (MIN_PASSWORD_LEN = 12) enforced backend-side before any Argon2id work. Counts Unicode scalar values (str::chars().count()), NOT UTF-8 byte length. Boolean accept/reject conformance category — an independent client that gates on byte length diverges on the multibyte cases. Cases generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_password_policy_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/password_policy.rs).

cases.description: Twelve ASCII 'a' — exactly at the floor; smallest accepted ASCII password.
Thirteen ASCII 'a' — one above the floor.
Eleven ASCII 'a' — one below the floor; rejected with PasswordTooShort.
Twelve precomposed 'á' (U+00E1): 12 USVs (accept) but 24 UTF-8 bytes. The USV-vs-byte discriminator — a port gating on byte length mis-handles this class.
Eleven precomposed 'á' (U+00E1): 11 USVs (reject) but 22 UTF-8 bytes. A byte-length gate would wrongly accept (22 >= 12).
Mixed Latin + Cyrillic + emoji at 13 USVs (above floor): USV counting across scripts plus a 4-byte astral scalar (U+1F510), independent of UTF-8 byte length.
